detail: Ink replaced Forge with Inkworks as its flagship builder program: Cohort 01 is taking rolling applications (one-page form, no deck needed). 8 teams get 6 weeks of working sessions with the Ink team and mentors, milestone-based funding, and a public launch plus a private VC demo day. No grant amount published. Verified on ink.works.
title: New on the registry: Inkworks — Ink's new flagship builder program, Cohort 01 open

detail: Ink's Forge track has stopped accepting applications: its official docs page now directs teams to apply to Inkworks instead. Forge offered milestone-based grants up to 200,000 USDC for teams scaling real products on Ink; that route is closed and Inkworks is the replacement. Spark ($500–$20,000) is unaffected and still open.
title: Ink Forge — no longer accepting applications

detail: Ink's Builder Program has a flagship track the registry was missing: Forge offers milestone-based grants up to 200,000 USDC for teams already scaling a real product on Ink (Kraken's L2), with live traction as the primary bar, plus hands-on ecosystem support and exposure through Ink's channels. It sits alongside Spark ($500–$20,000 for live projects getting started). Verified on Ink's official docs.
title: New on the registry: Ink Forge — milestone grants up to $200,000 for teams scaling on Ink

detail: CoW DAO's grants program is open and taking applications: funding for SDKs, integrations, solver tooling and research that advance CoW Protocol on Ethereum mainnet. Apply by posting on the CoW forum using the grant template; the Grants Committee votes on Snapshot over three days. Paid by milestone under the 2026 mandate (CIP-82), with the grants treasury on Ethereum Mainnet.
title: New on the registry: CoW DAO Grants — open, rolling, for CoW Protocol builders

detail: The Ethereum Foundation's Audit Subsidy Program is open and taking applications year-round: it covers up to 30% of a professional smart contract audit for teams building on Ethereum mainnet, from a $1M pool, booked through Areta Market (20+ audit firms). Any mainnet team can apply at any stage; CROPS-aligned projects get priority. Note: this is an audit subsidy applied to the audit cost, not a cash grant — and it is currently the only EF funding route accepting applications while ESP has no open Wishlist or RFP items.
title: New on the registry: Ethereum Audit Subsidy Program — up to 30% of your audit covered

detail: Shutter DAO opened Round 2 of its Impact Pilot for retroactive grants on BNB Chain: completed, verifiable work that advances an encrypted-mempool deployment. Evidence deadline 2026-12-21; awards decided by DAO vote in January. Amount not published.
title: New on the registry: Shutter DAO Impact Pilot Round 2 (BNB Chain) — deadline Dec 21

detail: Base backs independent creators already making content about Base — writers, streamers, podcasters, video creators and educators — with up to $4,000. Round 2 is closed and the application form is paused; Round 3 has not opened yet. GrantScope will flag it here the moment applications reopen.
title: New on the registry: Base Creator Grants — up to $4,000

detail: The GrantScope registry and wallet tracker are live, with 10 grant programs curated and dated across Base, Ethereum and BNB Chain (plus a few neighbouring ecosystems). GrantScope Pro is on its way: members will get every grant update by email the moment it lands. Statuses below were last verified 2026-11-22.
title: GrantScope is live — tracking 10 grant programs across Base, Ethereum & BNB Chain

detail: Small grants for builders shipping products that are live on Base only, with retroactive and proactive builder rewards for early-stage projects. Season 2 opened 2026-10-27; your project must be live on Base to qualify.
title: Base Builder Grants — open, up to $5,000

detail: Rolling applications for open-source projects building on or benefiting the BNB Chain ecosystem. Two-round review: a relevance and technical check, then a plan presentation where milestones and the grant amount are agreed. Winners are announced every two months.
title: BNB Chain Builder Grants — open, up to $200,000

detail: Connects BNB Chain builders to tools and services from ecosystem providers — cloud services, security audits, marketing, wallets and launchpads — as discounts, credits and in-kind support. Applicants choose which provider offerings to claim.
title: BNB Chain Kickstart — open, rolling applications

detail: Grants from the Uniswap Foundation for developers and projects building on Unichain (Uniswap's L2). Rolling applications.
title: Unichain Grants — open, up to $7,500

detail: Spark grants from the Ink Foundation for builders launching apps and infrastructure on Ink (Kraken's L2). Rolling applications.
title: Ink Spark — open, $500 – $20,000

detail: Milestone-based grants for open-source public goods and infrastructure on Solana, reviewed continuously. Tracked here for completeness alongside the Base, Ethereum and BNB Chain programs.
title: Solana Foundation Grants — open, rolling applications

detail: No grants round has run since October 2025; the program is between rounds. GrantScope will flag it here the moment a new round is announced.
title: Gitcoin Grants — between rounds

detail: As of 2026-11-22 the Ecosystem Support Program lists no open wishlist or RFP items, so applications are effectively paused. Direct inquiries remain the only route until new items appear.
title: Ethereum Foundation ESP — applications effectively paused

detail: Retroactive rewards for public goods on Optimism and the Superchain are paused since January 2026 for at least 12 months, with no restart date announced.
title: Optimism Retro Funding — paused

detail: Small, fast Instagrants (up to $10,000 in USDG) for Solana builders. All regional listings have shown Applications Paused since about April/May 2026, with no restart date.
title: Superteam Instagrants — applications paused
